# Feature Request

Thank you for suggesting an improvement to Tervynix.

## Summary

Describe the feature or improvement you would like to see.

## Problem

What developer problem would this feature solve?

Explain the current limitation, workflow issue, or missing capability.

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you think the feature could work.

You do not need to provide a complete technical design.

## Product Area

Which part of Tervynix does this relate to?

- [ ] Developer workspace
- [ ] Monaco editor
- [ ] Terminal
- [ ] Runtime management
- [ ] Process manager
- [ ] Port manager
- [ ] Runtime history
- [ ] Tasks
- [ ] Authentication
- [ ] Projects
- [ ] PostgreSQL / Persistence
- [ ] Realtime / WebSockets
- [ ] Backend architecture
- [ ] AI
- [ ] Cloud workspaces
- [ ] Deployment
- [ ] Collaboration
- [ ] Developer APIs
- [ ] Extensions
- [ ] Observability
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Other

## Example Workflow

Describe how a developer might use this feature.

1. Developer opens a project.
2. Developer starts an application.
3. Tervynix detects the running service.
4. The proposed feature provides...
